Gulf conflict has raised solvent and formulation prices; company is adjusting pricing.

timeline.summary: Best Agrolife filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 on May 7, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹100.01 Cr; net loss ₹21.72 Cr (against a loss of ₹9.45 Cr a year earlier).
Best Agrolife Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.10 per equity share for FY2025-26, subject to shareholder approval on May 27, 2026.
Best Agrolife filed its quarterly statement of deviation or variation in fund utilization under Regulation 32 for Q4 FY26.
Best Agrolife reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹156 Cr; and a net loss of ₹37 Cr due to raw material inflation and intentional sales curtailment.
Best Agrolife Limited confirms earnings conference call recording for Q4 FY2026 uploaded on May 28, 2026.
Best Agrolife Q4FY26 earnings call: FY26 revenue fell 31% to ₹1,257 Cr, PAT ₹9 Cr; management gave no FY27 guidance but expects better year on price hikes.
Vimal Kumar, Promoter & Managing Director of Best Agrolife Limited, declared no new encumbrances by promoters or promoter group for FY 2025-26 on April 04, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹407.12 Cr, net profit ₹57.46 Cr.
Best Agrolife reported a 48% YoY increase in Q2FY27 PAT to ₹57 Cr, driven by a higher share of patented products (60% of branded sales) despite a 21% revenue decline.
